name: Csharp Aesthetic Architecture
description: Enforce and apply modern, aesthetic C# architecture principles across .NET codebases. Provides opinionated guidance for Vertical Slice Architecture, CQRS, Minimal APIs, C# 12-14 language features, and clean code practices. Includes a 100+ item review checklist, anti-pattern detection with fixes, EF Core query patterns, and cross-cutting concern pipelines. The skill validates target framework prerequisites before suggesting newer C# syntax and covers naming conventions, premature optimization, composition over inheritance, functional patterns, and exception handling best practices.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `csharp-aesthetic-architecture`.

Installs with `claude plugin install csharp-aesthetic-architecture@claude-community` from `ChaseDRedmon/csharp-aesthetic-architecture`.

A Claude Code plugin for building, reviewing, and refactoring C# / .NET codebases using modern aesthetic architecture principles. Combines Vertical Slice Architecture, CQRS, functional design, modern C# idioms (C# 12-14), and clean code practices into a unified development philosophy.
